versions.changelog: Library-wide disclaimer: guidance, not professional advice
Description tail link + agents machine-readable metadata line (deciqai.com/s/tax-season-throughput-constraints.json)

- Initial release introducing tax-season throughput constraint skill based on theory-of-constraints.
- Provides domain-specific triggers and examples for bottleneck identification in tax preparation workflows.
- Includes guidance on when to activate (high volume, deadline pressure, bottleneck at reviewer/missing docs) and when not to (off-season, isolated issues).
- Offers packs and worked examples for solo practitioners and firms managing workload during tax season.
- Lists red flags for misapplication and verification steps to ensure correct constraint management.
